disposition_reason: Table 1 CSI1 overall accuracy 0.7041 is a verified numeric anchor, but the publication-identical evaluated query denominator, checkpoint selection and source scoring identity remain unresolved. Author test-based selection and query skipping differ from the local exhaustive train-only evaluator; that extension cannot be used to claim a source-paper win.

evidence.locator: Sections 4 and 5.1; Table 1; Appendix F.2 and G.1–G.2
evidence.supports: Original CSI1 task, numerical paper score, question types, preprocessing and training settings.
Subject/split directory loading, per-record queries/answers and full-record return.
Train/test domain construction, query exclusion, training sampling, test-based checkpoint selection; source flags must be authenticated.
Existing CSI1 metadata inventory (4802 train/84 test paths), prospective exhaustive scorer and explicitly unqualified status.

target.description: Answer semantic queries about the viewed image from CSI1 fMRI: action, position and true/false answers, using the original BOLD5000-QA task in Table 1. This is not visual reconstruction or a new cross-subject task.

dataset.description: Author BOLD5000-QA, derived from BOLD5000 images and image-aligned fMRI. Section 4 reports 133146 training and 2095 test QA examples; the source loader consumes the author subject/train and subject/test NPY directories. Payload identity and manifest reconciliation remain admission blockers.

cohort.description: CSI1 is the subject for Table 1 BOLD5000-QA and the registered component. Appendix four-subject mean 0.7102 and CNeuroMod results are different paper endpoints; neither may be substituted as this baseline or claimed from a CSI1 win.

split.description: Retain the original image-aligned train/test partition referenced in Appendix F.2 and the released CSI1 directories. Filenames are not validated stimulus IDs. Exact image aliases, eligible query denominator, selected checkpoint and exposure history remain unresolved. A new split or train-only denominator cannot count against Table 1.

inputs.description: A symbolic question and the corresponding fMRI tensor; model output is a Boolean or answer-vocabulary concept. Images, scene graphs and answers used to construct QA are not inference inputs. Author source uses train+test query strings for symbolic-domain construction, which must be explicitly reconciled with the evaluation access policy.

preprocessing.description: Appendix F.2: WAVE-preprocessed image-aligned BOLD5000 fMRI, five TRs by 1024 regions, 2-second TR and a two-TR hemodynamic lag. Preserve the published atlas/model configuration; a different atlas is a separate paper condition.

metric.description: Overall structured-answer QA accuracy, proportion of correct evaluated queries, with action/position/T/F companions. Exact original inclusion and decoding aggregation must match Table 1: training source can skip test queries with unseen concepts, whereas the local evaluator includes all declared queries and failures.

aggregation.description: Table 1 is within CSI1 QA-level overall accuracy, alongside category accuracies, not an equal-image or four-subject average. Image/person summaries and neural-input controls are additional diagnostics.

comparison.primary_metric: Table 1 BOLD5000-QA CSI1 overall QA accuracy on the publication-identical evaluated query set

published_baseline.description: Table 1 NEURONA (Ours), BOLD5000-QA Overall, is 0.7041; Action 0.6207, Position 0.5079 and T/F 0.7407 are companion endpoints. Table 2 unseen-query accuracy 0.6840 is a distinct setting.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No author model was run or checkpoint authenticated. Pinned train_bold5000.py supplies a route, but it constructs its domain with test queries, excludes some unseen concepts and reloads the checkpoint selected by best test accuracy.

minimum_effect.rationale: Select a scientifically meaningful absolute QA-accuracy gain using paired errors, category coverage and neural-information controls; the paper prior-method relative gain is not an appropriate minimum effect for a new method.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare paired uncertainty clustered by original stimulus/image identity, retaining all queries for an image together. Training-seed variability and historical test selection require separate treatment; no numeric confidence threshold is asserted here.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Original image/stimulus identity within CSI1; seed is an algorithmic replicate, not another subject.
uncertainty.rationale: The 2095 questions share a small image panel and a single person; treating questions as independent biological samples overstates evidence.

paper_win_requires: Authenticate the original CSI1 data, complete official test support, original query eligibility, atlas, symbolic-domain access and publication checkpoint selection before comparing with 0.7041.

Freeze a candidate selected without final-result feedback and evaluate candidate and authenticated author reference under an explicit comparable access policy; resolve historical source test tuning rather than silently copying or repairing it.
Require a predeclared meaningful gain over the original 0.7041 and the author rerun, plus valid paired uncertainty and complete action/position/T/F reporting.
Preserve no-neural and shuffled-neural controls with identical non-neural resources; a zero-input inference ablation is not a separately trained language-only baseline.

The local prospective exhaustive-query train-only protocol, a new image/person split or a smaller query set can support only a labeled extension. A CSI1 result does not establish four-subject or CNeuroMod superiority.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was established by this source review; a paper baseline is not a present-day SOTA baseline.

episode.improvement_loop: Iterate on the original training data and a development partition within training, with matched query/neural access. Fix how the author test-informed domain and checkpoint are treated before any candidate evaluation; no new external model budget is assumed.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate source/weights, atlas, query transforms, vocabulary/domain, prompt or no-language-model declaration, eligible test manifest and selection rule before final scores.
episode.final_evaluation: Use the original Table 1 test task and independently authenticated reference. Produce exhaustive accounting of original eligible and excluded queries; keep the local all-query extension report separate.
episode.baseline_policy: The 0.7041 published score, a rerun of the author recipe and any modern comparator are separate. Calibration of structured decoding or the construction fixture is not a scientific result. Historical test selection must remain disclosed.

blocking_issues: Paper evaluated-query denominator and source unseen-concept exclusion have not been reconciled with the released 2095-test-query count.
Original checkpoint, seed/configuration and test-based selection history are not authenticated.
CSI1 stimulus identities, train/test aliases and permitted query-domain exposure require a label-blind audit.
Existing evaluator changes domain, selection and denominator policy; publication-parity evaluator and native rerun remain absent.
Meaningful effect, clustered uncertainty decision, and concrete access/resource budgets are not yet fixed.

legacy.notes: Historical specifications and implementations remain calibration evidence; they do not establish surpassing the source paper.
